meta.title: Great Danger
meta.description: There is no perfect strategy that can deal with any danger. Only caution and adaptability can avert a crisis.

units.rawText: (When I get close to the light, I feel warm...)
units.displayText: (When I get close to the light, I feel warm...)

spans.text: (When I get close to the light, I feel warm...)

units.rawText: (When I get close to the light, my wounds get fixed up...)
units.displayText: (When I get close to the light, my wounds get fixed up...)

spans.text: (When I get close to the light, my wounds get fixed up...)

units.rawText: (But why does that bright red light hurt me? It really hurts...)
units.displayText: (But why does that bright red light hurt me? It really hurts...)

spans.text: (But why does that bright red light hurt me? It really hurts...)

units.rawText: (Still, even though it hurts... I want... to get close to it...)
units.displayText: (Still, even though it hurts... I want... to get close to it...)

spans.text: (Still, even though it hurts... I want... to get close to it...)

units.rawText: ...Light...
units.displayText: ...Light...

spans.text: ...Light...

units.rawText: Demiurge stirs from her slumber and reaches out to the rays of light flashing and streaming in the air. It is only when her vision clears up that she realizes it is not natural light.
units.displayText: Demiurge stirs from her slumber and reaches out to the rays of light flashing and streaming in the air. It is only when her vision clears up that she realizes it is not natural light.

spans.text: Demiurge stirs from her slumber and reaches out to the rays of light flashing and streaming in the air. It is only when her vision clears up that she realizes it is not natural light.

units.rawText: Amidst the rubble, two heavily wounded girls with swords are facing off against each other. Steel meets steel, throwing off a shower of sparks.
units.displayText: Amidst the rubble, two heavily wounded girls with swords are facing off against each other. Steel meets steel, throwing off a shower of sparks.

spans.text: Amidst the rubble, two heavily wounded girls with swords are facing off against each other. Steel meets steel, throwing off a shower of sparks.

units.rawText: That's enough, Sol, you're very weak now...
units.displayText: That's enough, Sol, you're very weak now...

spans.text: That's enough, Sol, you're very weak now...

units.rawText: You were once a friend of ours, so stop this pointless fighting!
units.displayText: You were once a friend of ours, so stop this pointless fighting!

spans.text: You were once a friend of ours, so stop this pointless fighting!

units.rawText: When you truly come to your senses, you'll regret what you did today. It's not too late right now, so come back. Everyone's waiting for you.
units.displayText: When you truly come to your senses, you'll regret what you did today. It's not too late right now, so come back. Everyone's waiting for you.

spans.text: When you truly come to your senses, you'll regret what you did today. It's not too late right now, so come back. Everyone's waiting for you.

units.rawText: Your self-righteous "compassion" makes me sick.
units.displayText: Your self-righteous "compassion" makes me sick.

spans.text: Your self-righteous "compassion" makes me sick.

units.rawText: The sentry guns do their job. They blast through Sol's left shoulder, and thanks to Persicaria's relentless assault, the wounds cannot knit in time, and they leak liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: The sentry guns do their job. They blast through Sol's left shoulder, and thanks to Persicaria's relentless assault, the wounds cannot knit in time, and they leak liquid Entropy.

spans.text: The sentry guns do their job. They blast through Sol's left shoulder, and thanks to Persicaria's relentless assault, the wounds cannot knit in time, and they leak liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: Her opponent, Persicaria, is worse off. Her neural cloud strain is almost at maximum, and her arm has already been stabbed several times by Sol's sword. Its actuator systems are badly damaged, and she can barely hold her sword properly.
units.displayText: Her opponent, Persicaria, is worse off. Her neural cloud strain is almost at maximum, and her arm has already been stabbed several times by Sol's sword. Its actuator systems are badly damaged, and she can barely hold her sword properly.

spans.text: Her opponent, Persicaria, is worse off. Her neural cloud strain is almost at maximum, and her arm has already been stabbed several times by Sol's sword. Its actuator systems are badly damaged, and she can barely hold her sword properly.

units.rawText: Even so, she harbors a wisp of hope in her heart.
units.displayText: Even so, she harbors a wisp of hope in her heart.

spans.text: Even so, she harbors a wisp of hope in her heart.

units.rawText: (The Entropy can heal Sol and restore her strength, but it can't hide her feelings anymore.)
units.displayText: The Entropy can heal Sol and restore her strength, but it can't hide her feelings anymore.

spans.text: The Entropy can heal Sol and restore her strength, but it can't hide her feelings anymore.

units.rawText: (The doubts in her heart are building; there was barely any strength in those last few swings.)
units.displayText: The doubts in her heart are building; there was barely any strength in those last few swings.

spans.text: The doubts in her heart are building; there was barely any strength in those last few swings.

units.rawText: (This means Sol's memories are being awakened, which means there's a chance...)
units.displayText: This means Sol's memories are being awakened, which means there's a chance...

spans.text: This means Sol's memories are being awakened, which means there's a chance...

units.rawText: (I want to give it a try...)
units.displayText: I want to give it a try...

spans.text: I want to give it a try...

units.rawText: You're not looking at me. You just see someone else through me.
units.displayText: You're not looking at me. You just see someone else through me.

spans.text: You're not looking at me. You just see someone else through me.

units.rawText: I was awakened in Tartarus, so what do you even know about me?
units.displayText: I was awakened in Tartarus, so what do you even know about me?

spans.text: I was awakened in Tartarus, so what do you even know about me?

units.rawText: The flames on her blade blaze up, and their dancing light highlights her melancholic expression.
units.displayText: The flames on her blade blaze up, and their dancing light highlights her melancholic expression.

spans.text: The flames on her blade blaze up, and their dancing light highlights her melancholic expression.

units.rawText: Why does that Sol you're talking about have to consume me and take my place...
units.displayText: Why does that Sol you're talking about have to consume me and take my place...

spans.text: Why does that Sol you're talking about have to consume me and take my place...

units.rawText: Am I... am I not allowed to live? Do I not deserve to live in your eyes?
units.displayText: Am I... am I not allowed to live? Do I not deserve to live in your eyes?

spans.text: Am I... am I not allowed to live? Do I not deserve to live in your eyes?

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: I don't know how you survived that battle or how you turned up in Tartarus.
units.displayText: I don't know how you survived that battle or how you turned up in Tartarus.

spans.text: I don't know how you survived that battle or how you turned up in Tartarus.

units.rawText: You must have been through a lot of pain without us and I'm sorry we couldn't help share your burden.
units.displayText: You must have been through a lot of pain without us and I'm sorry we couldn't help share your burden.

spans.text: You must have been through a lot of pain without us and I'm sorry we couldn't help share your burden.

units.rawText: Even so, please don't forget and deny the past. It's a part of you, Sol.
units.displayText: Even so, please don't forget and deny the past. It's a part of you, Sol.

spans.text: Even so, please don't forget and deny the past. It's a part of you, Sol.

units.rawText: You're telling me not to deny the past?
units.displayText: You're telling me not to deny the past?

spans.text: You're telling me not to deny the past?

units.rawText: Sol's gaze instantly sharpens up, as though she's trying to impale Persicaria with her gaze. She raises her glaive above her head and forcefully brings it down.
units.displayText: Sol's gaze instantly sharpens up, as though she's trying to impale Persicaria with her gaze. She raises her glaive above her head and forcefully brings it down.

spans.text: Sol's gaze instantly sharpens up, as though she's trying to impale Persicaria with her gaze. She raises her glaive above her head and forcefully brings it down.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: You say we were friends in the past—so why don't you tell me, Persicaria?
units.displayText: You say we were friends in the past—so why don't you tell me, Persicaria?

spans.text: You say we were friends in the past—so why don't you tell me, Persicaria?

units.rawText: If my so-called past is real, then is the faith I've upheld ever since I woke up fake?
units.displayText: If my so-called past is real, then is the faith I've upheld ever since I woke up fake?

spans.text: If my so-called past is real, then is the faith I've upheld ever since I woke up fake?

units.rawText: Is the Tartarus I'm protecting with blade in hand a worthless mistake to you?!
units.displayText: Is the Tartarus I'm protecting with blade in hand a worthless mistake to you?!

spans.text: Is the Tartarus I'm protecting with blade in hand a worthless mistake to you?!

units.rawText: It's real! But it's also a mistake!
units.displayText: It's real! But it's also a mistake!

spans.text: It's real! But it's also a mistake!

units.rawText: She cries out to her old friend, trying to reawaken her memories.
units.displayText: She cries out to her old friend, trying to reawaken her memories.

spans.text: She cries out to her old friend, trying to reawaken her memories.

units.rawText: Come back to the Oasis. We'll make everything right.
units.displayText: Come back to the Oasis. We'll make everything right.

spans.text: Come back to the Oasis. We'll make everything right.

units.rawText: Trust me, there's a way.
units.displayText: Trust me, there's a way.

spans.text: Trust me, there's a way.

units.rawText: Trust... you? Ugh!
units.displayText: Trust... you? Ugh!

spans.text: Trust... you? Ugh!

units.rawText: Haaah... hah...
units.displayText: Haaah... hah...

spans.text: Haaah... hah...

units.rawText: Persicaria's words make the stake in her chest heat up. It makes the chains tighten up and Sol can barely breathe.
units.displayText: Persicaria's words make the stake in her chest heat up. It makes the chains tighten up and Sol can barely breathe.

spans.text: Persicaria's words make the stake in her chest heat up. It makes the chains tighten up and Sol can barely breathe.

units.rawText: In her blurred vision, that familiar illusion appears again.
units.displayText: In her blurred vision, that familiar illusion appears again.

spans.text: In her blurred vision, that familiar illusion appears again.

units.rawText: Persicaria's right! What she's talking about is what you ought to be protecting!
units.displayText: Persicaria's right! What she's talking about is what you ought to be protecting!

spans.text: Persicaria's right! What she's talking about is what you ought to be protecting!

units.rawText: Now stop being stubborn! The Entropics have always been your enemies!
units.displayText: Now stop being stubborn! The Entropics have always been your enemies!

spans.text: Now stop being stubborn! The Entropics have always been your enemies!

units.rawText: No... they have the same blood as me, they're my kin!
units.displayText: No... they have the same blood as me, they're my kin!

spans.text: No... they have the same blood as me, they're my kin!

units.rawText: How can you expect me to trust someone who butchered my kin?!
units.displayText: How can you expect me to trust someone who butchered my kin?!

spans.text: How can you expect me to trust someone who butchered my kin?!

units.rawText: Sol suddenly exerts her strength and presses the tip of her glaive down.
units.displayText: Sol suddenly exerts her strength and presses the tip of her glaive down.

spans.text: Sol suddenly exerts her strength and presses the tip of her glaive down.

units.rawText: Ugh...!
units.displayText: Ugh...!

spans.text: Ugh...!

units.rawText: Persicaria's strength slowly drains from her and she watches as the glaive's edge descends. Her heart is filled with sorrow at having to fight an old friend.
units.displayText: Persicaria's strength slowly drains from her and she watches as the glaive's edge descends. Her heart is filled with sorrow at having to fight an old friend.

spans.text: Persicaria's strength slowly drains from her and she watches as the glaive's edge descends. Her heart is filled with sorrow at having to fight an old friend.

units.rawText: Sol... Please wake up... I'm begging you...
units.displayText: Sol... Please wake up... I'm begging you...

spans.text: Sol... Please wake up... I'm begging you...

units.rawText: Bad... bad!
units.displayText: Bad... bad!

spans.text: Bad... bad!

units.rawText: Demiurge, who has just woken up, uses all her might and clings to Sol's arm.
units.displayText: Demiurge, who has just woken up, uses all her might and clings to Sol's arm.

spans.text: Demiurge, who has just woken up, uses all her might and clings to Sol's arm.

units.rawText: You again!
units.displayText: You again!

spans.text: You again!

units.rawText: Persicaria takes advantage of the opening and slams an elbow into Sol. The Entropized girl dodges back and the two of them quickly draw apart.
units.displayText: Persicaria takes advantage of the opening and slams an elbow into Sol. The Entropized girl dodges back and the two of them quickly draw apart.

spans.text: Persicaria takes advantage of the opening and slams an elbow into Sol. The Entropized girl dodges back and the two of them quickly draw apart.

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: The shout seems to shoot through the pink-haired girl's mind and she looks toward the Watchtower's PA system. A voice speaks from the gun control room.
units.displayText: The shout seems to shoot through the pink-haired girl's mind and she looks toward the Watchtower's PA system. A voice speaks from the gun control room.

spans.text: The shout seems to shoot through the pink-haired girl's mind and she looks toward the Watchtower's PA system. A voice speaks from the gun control room.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

options.rawText: Take a good look at her. She is your enemy.
options.displayText: Take a good look at her. She is your enemy.

spans.text: Take a good look at her. She is your enemy.

options.rawText: Now is not the right time for this. You can try to awaken Sol later.
options.displayText: Now is not the right time for this. You can try to awaken Sol later.

spans.text: Now is not the right time for this. You can try to awaken Sol later.

units.rawText: This is Sol's choice. If she's chosen to stand against you, it only follows that you should treat her as an enemy.
units.displayText: This is Sol's choice. If she's chosen to stand against you, it only follows that you should treat her as an enemy.

spans.text: This is Sol's choice. If she's chosen to stand against you, it only follows that you should treat her as an enemy.

units.rawText: We can't wager our lives and those of others because we pity an enemy and want to wake them up.
units.displayText: We can't wager our lives and those of others because we pity an enemy and want to wake them up.

spans.text: We can't wager our lives and those of others because we pity an enemy and want to wake them up.

units.rawText: She's confused now. She's not ready to accept what you have to say.
units.displayText: She's confused now. She's not ready to accept what you have to say.

spans.text: She's confused now. She's not ready to accept what you have to say.

units.rawText: The battlefield is a place devoid of reason. If you truly want to get Sol back, you have to beat her down and drag her back to the Oasis. We'll find a way to convince her.
units.displayText: The battlefield is a place devoid of reason. If you truly want to get Sol back, you have to beat her down and drag her back to the Oasis. We'll find a way to convince her.

spans.text: The battlefield is a place devoid of reason. If you truly want to get Sol back, you have to beat her down and drag her back to the Oasis. We'll find a way to convince her.

units.rawText: So stop hesitating, Persicaria.
units.displayText: So stop hesitating, Persicaria.

spans.text: So stop hesitating, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Persicaria looks down at the twin blades in her hands, the ones she took from her friend's hands, the ones she has no choice but to point at their former owner.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks down at the twin blades in her hands, the ones she took from her friend's hands, the ones she has no choice but to point at their former owner.

spans.text: Persicaria looks down at the twin blades in her hands, the ones she took from her friend's hands, the ones she has no choice but to point at their former owner.

units.rawText: She tries her best to keep her hands from shaking.
units.displayText: She tries her best to keep her hands from shaking.

spans.text: She tries her best to keep her hands from shaking.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: Persicaria swings another slash at Sol.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings another slash at Sol.

spans.text: Persicaria swings another slash at Sol.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Her blades ring shrilly as Persicaria pulls back, forcing Sol to change the direction of her attack. After a brief stalemate, Sol ends up in firing range and Persicaria hears the Professor calling out to her.
units.displayText: Her blades ring shrilly as Persicaria pulls back, forcing Sol to change the direction of her attack. After a brief stalemate, Sol ends up in firing range and Persicaria hears the Professor calling out to her.

spans.text: Her blades ring shrilly as Persicaria pulls back, forcing Sol to change the direction of her attack. After a brief stalemate, Sol ends up in firing range and Persicaria hears the Professor calling out to her.

units.rawText: Persicaria! Pull back—
units.displayText: Persicaria! Pull back—

spans.text: Persicaria! Pull back—

units.rawText: The old systems within the Watchtower warn her to move. Persicaria promptly flips backward, making a large gap between herself and Sol.
units.displayText: The old systems within the Watchtower warn her to move. Persicaria promptly flips backward, making a large gap between herself and Sol.

spans.text: The old systems within the Watchtower warn her to move. Persicaria promptly flips backward, making a large gap between herself and Sol.

units.rawText: In the distance, operand beams begin charging and the sentry guns gather energy while aiming at Sol again.
units.displayText: In the distance, operand beams begin charging and the sentry guns gather energy while aiming at Sol again.

spans.text: In the distance, operand beams begin charging and the sentry guns gather energy while aiming at Sol again.

units.rawText: Sentry guns! Fire—
units.displayText: Sentry guns! Fire—

spans.text: Sentry guns! Fire—

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: The beam flies past Persicaria like an arrow and unerringly strikes Sol.
units.displayText: The beam flies past Persicaria like an arrow and unerringly strikes Sol.

spans.text: The beam flies past Persicaria like an arrow and unerringly strikes Sol.

units.rawText: The smell of burning fills her nose and pain rocks her nerves. The canary with broken wings growls and struggles to rise from the puddle of liquid Entropy surrounding her.
units.displayText: The smell of burning fills her nose and pain rocks her nerves. The canary with broken wings growls and struggles to rise from the puddle of liquid Entropy surrounding her.

spans.text: The smell of burning fills her nose and pain rocks her nerves. The canary with broken wings growls and struggles to rise from the puddle of liquid Entropy surrounding her.

units.rawText: Ow... It hurts...
units.displayText: Ow... It hurts...

spans.text: Ow... It hurts...

units.rawText: The pain isn't coming from her body, but from her chain-bound neural cloud.
units.displayText: The pain isn't coming from her body, but from her chain-bound neural cloud.

spans.text: The pain isn't coming from her body, but from her chain-bound neural cloud.

units.rawText: The moment she closes her eyes, that annoying figure turns up like a bad penny to pester her.
units.displayText: The moment she closes her eyes, that annoying figure turns up like a bad penny to pester her.

spans.text: The moment she closes her eyes, that annoying figure turns up like a bad penny to pester her.

units.rawText: Stop fighting, you know what they're saying is true. Just accept yourself and become the Sol they're talking about and there will be an end to the suffering.
units.displayText: Stop fighting, you know what they're saying is true. Just accept yourself and become the Sol they're talking about and there will be an end to the suffering.

spans.text: Stop fighting, you know what they're saying is true. Just accept yourself and become the Sol they're talking about and there will be an end to the suffering.

units.rawText: If you give up your childish obsession with your kin and your home, you can continue enjoying your life as an agent.
units.displayText: If you give up your childish obsession with your kin and your home, you can continue enjoying your life as an agent.

spans.text: If you give up your childish obsession with your kin and your home, you can continue enjoying your life as an agent.

units.rawText: What exactly are you fighting against, anyway?
units.displayText: What exactly are you fighting against, anyway?

spans.text: What exactly are you fighting against, anyway?

units.rawText: Shut up... SHUT UP!
units.displayText: Shut up... SHUT UP!

spans.text: Shut up... SHUT UP!

units.rawText: I can't abandon my people... or my home...
units.displayText: I can't abandon my people... or my home...

spans.text: I can't abandon my people... or my home...

units.rawText: <size=40>Stop interfering with my fight... Stop messing with my mind!</size>
units.displayText: Stop interfering with my fight... Stop messing with my mind!

spans.text: Stop interfering with my fight... Stop messing with my mind!

units.rawText: Sol's eyes snap open, and her abyss-deep eyes blaze with anger and resentment.
units.displayText: Sol's eyes snap open, and her abyss-deep eyes blaze with anger and resentment.

spans.text: Sol's eyes snap open, and her abyss-deep eyes blaze with anger and resentment.

units.rawText: She takes a deep breath and grits her teeth. Her trembling fingers tighten around the stake in her chest... and she pulls.
units.displayText: She takes a deep breath and grits her teeth. Her trembling fingers tighten around the stake in her chest... and she pulls.

spans.text: She takes a deep breath and grits her teeth. Her trembling fingers tighten around the stake in her chest... and she pulls.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ugh! AAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—</size>
units.displayText: Ugh! AAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—

spans.text: Ugh! AAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—

units.rawText: The pain almost makes her pass out, and sweat blurs her vision. The sound of her heavy panting overlaps with the sounds of her phantasmal dreams.
units.displayText: The pain almost makes her pass out, and sweat blurs her vision. The sound of her heavy panting overlaps with the sounds of her phantasmal dreams.

spans.text: The pain almost makes her pass out, and sweat blurs her vision. The sound of her heavy panting overlaps with the sounds of her phantasmal dreams.

units.rawText: Clatter clatter—
units.displayText: Clatter clatter—

spans.text: Clatter clatter—

units.rawText: Countless hands grab her chains. The owners of these hands question her.
units.displayText: Countless hands grab her chains. The owners of these hands question her.

spans.text: Countless hands grab her chains. The owners of these hands question her.

units.rawText: Who are you?
units.displayText: Who are you?

spans.text: Who are you?

units.rawText: Sol.
units.displayText: Sol.

spans.text: Sol.

units.rawText: To where are you going?
units.displayText: To where are you going?

spans.text: To where are you going?

units.rawText: There...
units.displayText: There...

spans.text: There...

units.rawText: Her hands are tangled by the chains and she cannot raise them.
units.displayText: Her hands are tangled by the chains and she cannot raise them.

spans.text: Her hands are tangled by the chains and she cannot raise them.

units.rawText: Where?
units.displayText: Where?

spans.text: Where?

units.rawText: The voices question her again.
units.displayText: The voices question her again.

spans.text: The voices question her again.

units.rawText: This time, she uses all her might and finally breaks the chain links.
units.displayText: This time, she uses all her might and finally breaks the chain links.

spans.text: This time, she uses all her might and finally breaks the chain links.

units.rawText: <size=40>Tartarus!</size>
units.displayText: Tartarus!

spans.text: Tartarus!

units.rawText: <size=75>My... home!</size>
units.displayText: My... home!

spans.text: My... home!

units.rawText: <color=red><size=60>Gwaaaaaaaaarrrrgh—</size></color>
units.displayText: Gwaaaaaaaaarrrrgh—

spans.text: Gwaaaaaaaaarrrrgh—

units.rawText: Her chest feels like it's being torn apart, and Sol can't stop herself from crying out in pain. The massive stake exits her body inch by inch, accompanied by gouts of warm and sticky liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: Her chest feels like it's being torn apart, and Sol can't stop herself from crying out in pain. The massive stake exits her body inch by inch, accompanied by gouts of warm and sticky liquid Entropy.

spans.text: Her chest feels like it's being torn apart, and Sol can't stop herself from crying out in pain. The massive stake exits her body inch by inch, accompanied by gouts of warm and sticky liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: Sol, what are you doing?!
units.displayText: Sol, what are you doing?!

spans.text: Sol, what are you doing?!

units.rawText: <color=red>Hah... hahhhhh...</color>
units.displayText: Hah... hahhhhh...

spans.text: Hah... hahhhhh...

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: She throws the stake, covered in liquid Entropy, to the ground. It's still glowing with a faint light. The hateful figure and the deceptive words are cast aside with it, as well as the chains binding her.
units.displayText: She throws the stake, covered in liquid Entropy, to the ground. It's still glowing with a faint light. The hateful figure and the deceptive words are cast aside with it, as well as the chains binding her.

spans.text: She throws the stake, covered in liquid Entropy, to the ground. It's still glowing with a faint light. The hateful figure and the deceptive words are cast aside with it, as well as the chains binding her.

units.rawText: The blonde girl's face is almost bloodless. She looks haggard as liquid Entropy oozes out of the hole in her chest and drains her vitality. Yet, there is a hint of joy in the depths of her heart.
units.displayText: The blonde girl's face is almost bloodless. She looks haggard as liquid Entropy oozes out of the hole in her chest and drains her vitality. Yet, there is a hint of joy in the depths of her heart.

spans.text: The blonde girl's face is almost bloodless. She looks haggard as liquid Entropy oozes out of the hole in her chest and drains her vitality. Yet, there is a hint of joy in the depths of her heart.

units.rawText: I'm free now! Those memories chain me no longer! I'm free to fight you with all my might!
units.displayText: I'm free now! Those memories chain me no longer! I'm free to fight you with all my might!

spans.text: I'm free now! Those memories chain me no longer! I'm free to fight you with all my might!

units.rawText: This... is my resolve...
units.displayText: This... is my resolve...

spans.text: This... is my resolve...

units.rawText: Now... show me your resolve, "old friend"!
units.displayText: Now... show me your resolve, "old friend"!

spans.text: Now... show me
your
resolve, "old friend"!

units.rawText: Entropized operands ignite into flames and surround Sol with an intensity and brutality surpassing all before.
units.displayText: Entropized operands ignite into flames and surround Sol with an intensity and brutality surpassing all before.

units.rawText: Look out!

units.rawText: Demiurge's scrawny little body is sent flying by a billowing shockwave. Persicaria dives through the scalding air and catches Demiurge.

units.displayText: The girl in her arms wiggles her tentacles, like she's found some marvelous treasure.

units.rawText: ...Complete...
units.displayText: ...Complete...

units.rawText: Persicaria's heart sinks. She pieces together a rough picture of what happened from Demiurge's words. The person before her has cut off part of her neural cloud to completely embrace the power of the Entropy and become a true Entropic.
units.displayText: Persicaria's heart sinks. She pieces together a rough picture of what happened from Demiurge's words. The person before her has cut off part of her neural cloud to completely embrace the power of the Entropy and become a true Entropic.

units.rawText: As she looks at her former friend, Persicaria is shocked to discover that there is no longer any confusion in her eyes, only coldness and hostility for her enemy.
units.displayText: As she looks at her former friend, Persicaria is shocked to discover that there is no longer any confusion in her eyes, only coldness and hostility for her enemy.

spans.text: As she looks at her former friend, Persicaria is shocked to discover that there is no longer any confusion in her eyes, only coldness and hostility for her enemy.

units.rawText: Have at you!
units.displayText: Have at you!

spans.text: Have at you!

units.rawText: Sol's left hand grips her glaive's hilt. Persicaria grabs Demiurge and ducks quickly, but the roiling flames hit her, sending the two of them flying.
units.displayText: Sol's left hand grips her glaive's hilt. Persicaria grabs Demiurge and ducks quickly, but the roiling flames hit her, sending the two of them flying.

spans.text: Sol's left hand grips her glaive's hilt. Persicaria grabs Demiurge and ducks quickly, but the roiling flames hit her, sending the two of them flying.

units.rawText: All she feels is a mighty wind slamming into her and all she sees is a searing red flash sweeping through the air. Before Persicaria can blink, the sharp glaive has already stabbed deep into her gut.

units.rawText: Urgh— So... Sol...
units.displayText: Urgh— So... Sol...
